integrity: Ordinary mathematical proof supplemented by a standalone finite-range regression checker. Literature coverage and self-review do not establish independent certification or exhaustive novelty.
scientific_limitations: Only canonical palindromic Zeckendorf words; exact parity and gcd by length, excluding empty length two from gcd. No odd-prime distribution; non-indexed identical prior coverage is possible.
title: Parity resonance and common divisors of palindromic Zeckendorf integers
